t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes are variable values.  Blue did better in earlier rounds, orange better towards the end.  Darker colours did okay.  But best to just try your own strategy.

vb_textbox.text: There appears to be no pattern at all to the scoring of the gnomes.  Choose as you like, just concentrate, and don't miss selecting one (or the basket)! Good luck!
